narrative.overview: A Gradelyy-inspired dark workspace uses blue actions, crisp typography, and layered neutral surfaces to support sustained study. Reading remains central; performance evidence and Java practice extend the original sequential course without replacing it.
keyCharacteristics: Dark neutral surfaces with purposeful blue accents.
Sora headings and DM Sans reading text.
Sequential lessons, explicit algorithm states, and targeted review.
Optional light appearance with the same component structure.
dos: Do preserve the original lesson sequence and mastery progression.
Do distinguish latest learning evidence, self-reported testing, and entered official marks.
Do keep both appearances readable with visible focus and explicit feedback.
donts: Don't present local Java testing as automatic grading.
Don't replace concrete algorithm states with decorative graphics.
